title: (Updated) Microsoft Viva Engage: Reducing reply notification volume in email
summary: Microsoft Viva Engage will reduce email reply notifications by only sending alerts for direct replies, @mentions, and new posts, not for all conversation replies. The update rolls out globally from September to November 2026, requires no action, and keeps existing notification settings unchanged.
body:
Updated November 16, 2026: We have updated the timeline. Thank you for your patience. 

[What and why]

Microsoft Viva Engage is updating email reply notifications to make them more relevant and intent-driven. With this change, users will continue to receive email notifications for interactions that directly involve them, such as direct replies and @mentions, while notification emails generated from broader participation in conversations will be reduced.

This update is designed to help users focus on the conversations most relevant to them and reduce unnecessary email volume. Existing community subscription settings and other notification controls will remain unchanged.

[Rollout schedule]

- General Availability (Worldwide): Beginning in early September 2026 and expected to complete by end of November 2026 (previously late October)[Impact on your organization]

Who is affected

- Users who receive Microsoft Viva Engage notifications through email- Organizations that use Viva Engage communities or storylines- Users who participate in Viva Engage conversationsPlatforms and services

- Microsoft Viva Engage- Viva Engage email notificationsWhat will happen

After this rollout:

Users will continue to receive email notifications when:

- They start a conversation.- Someone directly replies to their post or comment.- They are @mentioned.Users will no longer be automatically subscribed to all future replies in a conversation because they:

- Read the conversation.- Commented on the conversation.Community subscribers will continue to receive notifications for new posts and announcements.

Storyline followers will continue to receive notifications for new posts and announcements.

Existing user notification preferences and tenant-level controls will remain unchanged.

No new admin settings, policies, or controls will be introduced.

The change will be enabled automatically as part of the service update.

[Action required and recommendations]

No action is required.

You may want to:

- Review and update internal documentation that describes Viva Engage email notifications.- Update training and support materials that reference reply notification behavior.- Inform support and help desk teams that users may notice a reduction in email notifications from active conversations.- Gather user feedback after rollout is complete.[Compliance considerations]

No compliance considerations identified, review as appropriate for your organization.
bodyHtml:
Updated November 16, 2026: We have updated the timeline. Thank you for your patience. 

[What and why]

Microsoft Viva Engage is updating email reply notifications to make them more relevant and intent-driven. With this change, users will continue to receive email notifications for interactions that directly involve them, such as direct replies and @mentions, while notification emails generated from broader participation in conversations will be reduced.

This update is designed to help users focus on the conversations most relevant to them and reduce unnecessary email volume. Existing community subscription settings and other notification controls will remain unchanged.

[Rollout schedule]

  • General Availability (Worldwide): Beginning in early September 2026 and expected to complete by end of November 2026 (previously late October)

[Impact on your organization]

Who is affected

  • Users who receive Microsoft Viva Engage notifications through email
  • Organizations that use Viva Engage communities or storylines
  • Users who participate in Viva Engage conversations

Platforms and services

  • Microsoft Viva Engage
  • Viva Engage email notifications

What will happen

After this rollout:

Users will continue to receive email notifications when:

  • They start a conversation.
  • Someone directly replies to their post or comment.
  • They are @mentioned.

Users will no longer be automatically subscribed to all future replies in a conversation because they:

  • Read the conversation.
  • Commented on the conversation.

Community subscribers will continue to receive notifications for new posts and announcements.

Storyline followers will continue to receive notifications for new posts and announcements.

Existing user notification preferences and tenant-level controls will remain unchanged.

No new admin settings, policies, or controls will be introduced.

The change will be enabled automatically as part of the service update.

[Action required and recommendations]

No action is required.

You may want to:

  • Review and update internal documentation that describes Viva Engage email notifications.
  • Update training and support materials that reference reply notification behavior.
  • Inform support and help desk teams that users may notice a reduction in email notifications from active conversations.
  • Gather user feedback after rollout is complete.

[Compliance considerations]

No compliance considerations identified, review as appropriate for your organization.
